content: We live in succession, in division, in parts, in particles. Meantime within man is the soul of the whole; the wise silence; the universal beauty.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Though daily existence fragments our attention into disparate tasks and anxieties, the unchanging essence within remains whole, silent, and unbound.
practicalInsight: Take three conscious breaths and sink below the choppy surface of your thoughts into the stillness underneath.
reflectionPrompt: Where can you find a moment of wise silence in your schedule today?
